SKILL BANNERS & TRAIT ICONS — PROOF OF CONCEPT v3

Icon grammar: solid "D" block = skill, diagonal stripe with black wedge = focus, color = specialty, tricolor = Any, black ? = Variable. Skills are now banner-only (no text) in every variant. Two focus treatments are presented below for comparison.
